name: Console: Auctions and Buy Now chips

who.value: seller running a live auction on the web console

job.value: keep up with auctions while leaving Buy Now orders for later, filtered by chips

arrivedFrom.value: starting the show from the seller web console

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Orders (13)' with chips 'All 13', 'Auctions 8', 'Buy Now' beside the stream, 'Shop items', 'Live stats' and chat reads as a live seller console.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The chips are prominent in the Orders panel, but the green '+' and live stream compete across four dense panels.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Chips and 'Show notes'/'Giveaway' are clear, but 'Antisniping' and 'Auction tiers' don't say what tapping does.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Antisniping', 'Auction tiers' and 'Ready to…' appear without explanation, though a regular host likely knows them.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Filtering orders by type is a call a host can make mid-show.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Full UUID order IDs ('O39bb376d-c062-…') and 'Payment Status' lines show on every order row up front.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Orders, shop items, stats and chat are all live-show console content.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Panels mostly use labels and numbers, but each order row is three lines of 'Sold to … for …', status and order ID.
